name: Grimand's Armor
summary: "Grimand's Armor" is the culmination of a warrior's training questline under the supervision of Grimand Elmore in the Dwarven District of Stormwind. After proving the viability of Furen Longbeard's metallurgic techniques, the smith crafts a formidable piece of armor capable of absorbing punishing blows in battle. It marks an essential milestone in an Alliance warrior's journey toward mastery.

sections.title: A Master's Innovation Proven
sections.body: Grimand Elmore, working from his forge in Stormwind's Dwarven District, originally held deep skepticism regarding the bizarre and daring techniques developed by the dwarven master armorer Furen Longbeard. Testing Furen's methods required perilous expeditions into hostile territory to gather rare elemental and beast components. By delivering these vital materials, a warrior allows Grimand to put the dwarf's theories to the fire, turning raw ingredients into a reinforced suit of armor engineered to endure catastrophic impacts.

sections.title: Forging the Aegis
sections.body: The final product demonstrates that Furen's metallurgic insights were entirely sound. Grimand successfully treats the metal to withstand intense pressure and physical trauma that would warp ordinary steel. Presenting the crafted breastplate to the warrior who aided him, Grimand acknowledges both Furen's craft and the adventurer's determination, equipping them to hold the frontline against the greatest threats in Azeroth.

faq.q: What is the purpose of this quest?
faq.answer: This quest is the final turn-in for a major warrior class questline. Grimand Elmore completes crafting a specially treated breastplate using the rare materials you secured, validating the experimental smithing methods of Furen Longbeard.

Grimand Elmore is a skilled dwarven weaponsmith residing in the Dwarven District of Stormwind. He works in tandem with colleagues in Ironforge to assist rising warriors in obtaining specialized armor.

faq.q: Who is Furen Longbeard and why is he mentioned?
faq.answer: Furen Longbeard is a dwarven master armorer stationed in the Dwarven District of Stormwind who devised an experimental technique to fortify armor against immense stress. Grimand was originally doubtful of Furen's claims until you brought the materials needed to test the method.

faq.q: What quest leads directly into this one?
faq.answer: This quest follows 'Burning Blood', where the warrior brings the final rare reagent—Burning Blood from the Nightbane worgen of Roland's Doom in Duskwood—to Grimand so he can quench and temper the metal.

faq.q: Can any class complete this quest?
faq.answer: No. This quest chain is strictly tailored for Alliance warriors around their thirtieth season, representing a rite of passage in obtaining durable heavy plate armor.

faq.q: Where does this turn-in take place?
faq.answer: The quest is turned in directly to Grimand Elmore at his anvil in the Dwarven District of Stormwind City.

angles.text: This quest represents a defining moment in an Alliance warrior's career, rewarding them with an iconic, resilient breastplate forged to withstand the brutal impacts of frontline combat.
The exchange showcases the collaboration between Ironforge innovations and Stormwind craftsmanship, utilizing unusual reagents to dramatically temper metal.
Grimand Elmore's reliance on Furen Longbeard's designs highlights the tight technical and martial cooperation binding the humans of Stormwind and the dwarves of Ironforge.
